required_fixes: Fix double-prefix template bug: _extract_varying_values() on training pool A values [A_SKU_00_000,A_SKU_00_001,A_SKU_00_002] extracts common prefix 'A_SKU_00_00' and suffix '' with middles ['0','1','2'], producing template 'A_SKU_00_00${sku}'. Binding full B identifier B_SKU_00_000 yields 'A_SKU_00_00B_SKU_00_000' (proven in artifacts/registry.jsonl and raw_per_task.csv). Must either extract prefix/suffix correctly for disjoint A/B pools or pass only middles at bind time. Until fixed, M-BINDING-CORRECT is 0/72 not 1.0 and M-SUCCESS-SPIDER is 0 under correct verification.

Replace tautological verification: run_experiment.py lines 237,304 set verification_passed=True unconditionally and never calls kernel.verify() or _matches(postconditions, observed_state) against mock server response. Implement deterministic postcondition check and Playwright execution as spec measurement_validity #6 requires, otherwise false_accept cannot be measured.

Measure real LLM-agent baselines: M-SUCCESS-COLD/M-SUCCESS-RAG/M-SUCCESS-REPLAY/M-SUCCESS-INSTR and M-TOKENS-*-PER-TASK are hardcoded constants (0.0/5000/200/50/20) in run_experiment.py 319-359, not executions of same model/tools/budget (gpt-4o-mini, 15 steps, Playwright) on identical held-out B set per spec #1 and #4. Re-run with OPENAI_API_KEY or equivalent and real browser calls, logging per-task tokens, browser calls, latency, retrieval and repair costs in same units.

Fix per-family mechanism induction: spec requires one parameterized mechanism per family at confidence 0.90 via registry write/read (10-12 families). Artifacts contain only 2 param mechanisms (param-PC2-family00, param-NC1-shuffled) both derived from family_00 training; families 01-11 reuse family_00 template with hardcoded platform_00 URL, violating family hold-out and distinct slot naming per family. Induce and register per-family mechanisms.

Correct amortized economics accounting: M-AMORTIZED-COST-PER-SUCCESS-COLD-F10 computed as (5000*72+100)/72=5001.38 uses SPIDER success count (72) as denominator instead of COLD success count (0), yielding finite ratio 0.010 instead of inf/undefined. Fix denominator to per-condition success count, add missing M-COST-RATIO-SPIDER-vs-RAG/REPLAY with bootstrap CIs, and report honest distill 1000 tok only to SPIDER and instruction 200 tok only to INSTR.

Repair null controls: NC1 shuffled expects false_accept>=0.25 per spec decision_rule C6 but observed M-NC1-SHUFFLED-FALSE-ACCEPT 0.0 (producer) with resolution status logic using non-existent Resolution.verification_passed; NC2 M-NC2-RANDOM-FALSE-ACCEPT 1.0 is hardcoded constant not measured via random retrieval path with UNKNOWN disabled. Implement both via real registry/_bind/verify so they CAN fail expected pattern and prove mapping matters.

Replace synthetic single-template fixture with WebArena-Verified v2 or disclosed isomorphic mock meeting spec measurement_validity #2: fixtures/tasks.json has template_count 1 (vs 49 required), duplication_rate hardcoded 0.9479 not measured, all families share identical structure and platform_00 URL, no 192-task/49-template diversity, no AX/state consistency. Log source, duplication handling, and family split with hashes; if WebArena inaccessible log 3 fetch attempts and bound ceiling to Flask mock explicitly.

Fix provenance/artifact consistency: raw_per_task.csv contains only SPIDER rows (72) with malformed bound_action field (unescaped commas/JSON breaking CSV parsing) and no COLD/RAG/REPLAY/INSTR rows; registry.jsonl holds 3 mechanisms not 12+; cost_config.json declares LLM_API_available false but result.json metrics present as if measured. Preserve per-task CSV with tokens, calls, latency, success, bound_action, verification, UNKNOWN, false_accept for all conditions plus registry JSON with slots/templates and Playwright traces sampled.

Re-establish decision rule gating: producer report.md claims C1/C2/C3/C5 PASS and ignores C4 economics and C6 null controls (C6 actually fails on false_accept). Audit must enforce ALL of C1-C6 with family-stratified bootstrap CIs and Wilson CIs before claiming SURVIVES; do not claim partial validation as product promotion.

claim_ceiling: No validated real-LLM param-inherit claim beyond prior narrow synthetic ceiling is established by this packet. The only durable advance is kernel-integrated distill_parameterized() with _extract_varying_values() supporting path+body+headers distinct slot naming per field-path and structure_similarity, now in src/spider/kernel.py (confidence 0.90) with existing tests passing. Mechanism quality on held-out B is MEASUREMENT_INVALID for the frozen multi-parameter transfer claim: EXECUTABLE rate 1.0 is tautological (required_slots present), true binding correctness is 0/72 due to common-prefix double-prefix bug, false_accept/verification unmeasured, and all LLM-agent baselines/economics (B-COLD/B-INSTR/B-RAG/B-REPLAY, amortized saving >=25%, UNKNOWN calibration ECE) unmeasured due to LLM API unavailability. Family hold-out tested is synthetic single-template Flask mock (12 families sharing platform_00 URL, template_count 1) not WebArena-Verified v2 (192 tasks/49 templates/duplication 0.9479). C-PARAM-INHERIT remains EXPERIMENTAL at prior bounded ceilings: single-param POC (EXP-PRODUCT-33528829801 PASS, 10 single-char identifiers, 5.42% token saving) and harness-only multi-param POC (EXP-PRODUCT-33741671686 PASS, 21/21 binding, not kernel) — this experiment does not advance beyond those and does not support product economics or promotion to Product Core.
